cues.en: In production, we shall use Gunicorn alongside Uvicorn.
cues.zh: 正式環境會搭配 Gunicorn 與 Uvicorn。

cues.en: Uvicorn will still remain as our Ascii server that will provide the implementation needed for our fast API async capabilities.
cues.zh: Uvicorn 仍作為 ASGI 伺服器，提供 FastAPI 非同步能力所需的實作。

cues.en: Then Genikon, which is a Wsgi server for Python, will serve as a process manager that will manage multiple uvicorn worker processes.
cues.zh: Gunicorn 是 Python 的 WSGI 伺服器，在這裡作為程序管理器，管理多個 Uvicorn worker 程序。

cues.en: So why are we going to use Gunicorn with fast API?
cues.zh: 為什麼 FastAPI 要搭配 Gunicorn？

cues.en: One Genikon allows us to manage multiple worker processes efficiently.
cues.zh: 第一，Gunicorn 可以有效管理多個 worker 程序。

cues.en: Then two running multiple gunicorn workers improves the handling of concurrent requests.
cues.zh: 第二，多個 Gunicorn worker 可以改善並行請求處理。

cues.en: And lastly, we shall be using Gunicorn to handle any restarts, logging and worker management.
cues.zh: 最後，透過 Gunicorn 處理重新啟動、紀錄與 worker 管理。

cues.en: And so to end Genikon we're going to open our requirements dot txt file.
cues.zh: 要加入 Gunicorn，先開啟 requirements.txt。
